lines.en: label dormwarssix4:
scene rocketshadowlegends
ARBY’S.
lines.zh: ARBY’S。

lines.en: scene familywar1
: Okay, Chinami. Your big sister is still broken, so I’m going to take over as your legal guardian for now. Which, coincidentally, is also the same way I got adopted, I think.
lines.zh: : 好了，Chinami。你姐姐还没修好，所以在那之前我来当你的临时监护人。巧的是，我猜我也是这么被收养的。

lines.en: : Chinami is confused. Does this make you her new mom?
lines.zh: : Chinami 有点困惑。那这是否意味着你成了她的新妈妈？

lines.en: : Not legally. But you can pretend I am until Chika’s brain stops being a slushy if that makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 法律上不是。不过如果这样能让你开心，在 Chika 的脑子不再是冰沙之前，你可以把我当成妈妈。

lines.en: : How can we know this is even her and not just a really well-made wax sculpture?
lines.zh: : 我们怎么知道这是她本人，而不是一尊做得特别逼真的蜡像？

lines.en: : My mind is here. I just can’t move my body.
lines.zh: : 我的意识在这儿。我只是动不了身体。

lines.en: : Don’t listen to her. Her mind is most certainly {i}not{/i} here. What you are experiencing now is little more than fumes in the gas tank that is her existence. And she will soon fade away into nothing.
lines.zh: : 别听她的。她的意识绝对{i}不{/i}在这儿。你现在体验到的，不过是她存在这个油箱里剩下的一点点油气。她很快就会消散成虚无。

lines.en: : This sounds problematic. Chinami always assumed that big sis Chika would be the one making funeral arrangements for her.
lines.zh: : 听起来很成问题。Chinami 一直以为会给她办葬礼的是 Chika 姐姐。

lines.en: : Well, Chinami, there’s actually something we can do about that right now. Are you familiar with the Dorm Wars?
lines.zh: : 那个，Chinami，其实我们现在就能为此做点什么。你了解宿舍战争吗？

lines.en: scene familywar2
: Yeah! Chinami got to participate in the first one and devised a ploy where she would drop dinner on purpose so that Papa would think it was cute and big sis Chika would win the date war.
lines.zh: : 知道！Chinami 参加了第一届，还设计了一个计谋：故意把晚饭掉在地上，好让 Papa 觉得可爱，让 Chika 姐姐赢下约会战争。

lines.en: : And she thinks it worked because big sis Chika was really happy the next time she came home! But that was also before all of the sex started and big sis Chika’s descent into madness began.
lines.zh: : 而且她觉得奏效了，因为 Chika 姐姐下次回家时特别开心！不过那也是在所有性爱开始之前、在 Chika 姐姐陷入疯狂之前的事了。

lines.en: : Stop talking about sex. You aren’t old enough.
lines.zh: : 别再说性了。你还不够大。

lines.en: : That-
: She’s just on auto-pilot, I promise you. But also, she’s right. Don’t talk about that stuff anymore. Especially not in front of your friends.
lines.zh: : 我向你保证，她只是在自动巡航。不过她说的也对。别再说那些了。尤其别在你朋友面前说。

lines.en: if tsukasacurious == True:
scene familywar3
: Tell that to her! Tsukasa’s the one that planted this seed in Chinami! She just wanted to be a normal little girl!
lines.zh: : 这话你去跟她说啊！在 Chinami 心里种下这颗种子的是 Tsukasa！她只是想当个普通的小女孩！

lines.en: : Realistically, this is all Jeeves’ fault. He’s the one who planted the seed in me.
lines.zh: : 说到底这都是 Jeeves 的错。在我心里种下种子的是他。

lines.en: scene familywar4
: Okay! Nobody’s planting seeds in anybody so long as I’m in charge.
lines.zh: : 好了！只要我在这儿负责，谁也不许往谁心里种种子。

lines.en: : It was hard enough just convincing the camera crew to stay outside. The last thing I need is two wizards fighting for reproductive rights in the middle of a contest. Got it?
lines.zh: : 光是说服摄制组待在门外就已经够费劲了。我最不需要的，就是两个巫师在比赛中间为生育权打起来。明白吗？

lines.en: : Contest? You mean we get to participate in your genocide this time?
lines.zh: : 比赛？你是说这回我们也可以参与你们的种族灭绝了？

lines.en: scene familywar5
: It’s not a genocide! We just need the two of you to choose who you’d rather have in your family out of the two other girls we dragged in here who haven’t spoken yet!
lines.zh: : 这根本不是种族灭绝！我们只需要你俩从另外两个被我们拽进来、还没开口说话的女生里，选出你更想让谁进你们家！

lines.en: scene familywar6
: Damn. I was starting to hope she’d forgotten about us.
lines.zh: : 糟了。我还开始指望她已经把我们忘了呢。

lines.en: : Are you not good with kids, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你不太擅长应付小孩吗，Otoha？

lines.en: scene familywar7
: I just don’t have much experience with them. Even when I was younger, I didn’t spend much time playing with kids my age since I was too busy with music lessons and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我只是没什么跟小孩打交道的经验。就算我小时候，也没怎么跟同龄的孩子玩，因为我要上音乐课什么的，太忙了。

lines.en: : I guess being an only child doesn’t help either then, huh? I’m in the same boat there. No siblings for me.
lines.zh: : 那独生女的身份也没帮上忙吧？我也一样。我没有兄弟姐妹。

lines.en: : On a technical level, sure. But you’ve had Sensei by your side for years and he’s been the same age as us mentally for over a decade.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，是的。可你有 Sensei 在身边这么多年，而他心理年龄跟我们一样已经十多年了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I like him that way. It’s easier to get what I want and I know he won’t ever leave me because he’s not mentally mature enough to survive on his own.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我就喜欢他这样。这样我更容易得到想要的，而且我知道他永远不会离开我，因为他的心智还不够成熟，没法独自生存。

lines.en: : Did you mean to say that out loud or are we just suddenly friends and you don’t mind confiding in me?
lines.zh: : 你是故意说出来的，还是说我们突然成了朋友，所以你不介意跟我交心？

lines.en: : I think it’s more that I just stopped caring about the consequences of my actions because I know they will enrich my life regardless of their potential negative impact on the world around me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更多是因为我不在乎自己行为的后果了——因为我知道，无论它们对周围世界有什么负面影响，都会让我的人生更丰富。

lines.en: : You’re weird. But I kind of like it.
lines.zh: : 你真怪。不过我还挺喜欢的。

lines.en: : Thanks. I kind of like you too. Maybe we {i}should{/i} be friends?
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我也挺喜欢你的。也许我们{i}真该{/i}做朋友？

lines.en: scene familywar8
: {i}Ahem.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}咳咳。{/i}

lines.en: scene familywar9
: If you two are done flirting, I’d like to explain the rules of the contest now.
lines.zh: : 如果你俩调情调完了，我现在要讲比赛规则了。

lines.en: : We’re not flirting. It’d be weird for me to pursue Ami at the same time you’re pursuing her dad. The dynamic would be so weird if both couples got together.
lines.zh: : 我们没在调情。我追 Ami 的同时你在追她爸，这也太怪了。要是两对都成了，那关系得多诡异。

lines.en: : Otoha’s right. Just leave my dad to me and the two of you can start dating again.
lines.zh: : Otoha 说得对。我爸交给我就行，你俩可以重新开始约会。

lines.en: : Don’t say anything that might get me killed inside of Chika’s house, thanks.
lines.zh: : 拜托别说些会让我死在 Chika 家里的话，谢谢。

lines.en: : There are so many places to hide a body here.
lines.zh: : 这儿藏尸体的地方可太多了。

lines.en: scene familywar10
: I agree. That was the first thing I thought after I moved in.
lines.zh: : 我同意。我搬进来之后第一个想到的就是这个。

lines.en: : Why?!
lines.zh: : 为什么啊？！

lines.en: scene familywar11

: To protect myself, obviously! From both being murdered and the legal ramifications that would come from murdering someone on my own. Which I don’t {i}intend{/i} to do, but I could. And that’s what matters.
lines.zh: : 当然是为了保护自己！既防被人杀，也防自己杀人之后要承担的法律后果。我{i}并不打算{/i}杀人，但我有能力。而这才是最重要的。

lines.en: : Okay! Cool! You’re both obviously very smart for your age, so figuring out what you’re supposed to do here should be no trouble at all.
lines.zh: : 好！酷！以你们的年纪，你们俩显然都聪明得过头了，所以搞清楚在这儿该做什么应该完全不成问题。

lines.en: : Just...form pairs or something and then play house or whatever. Or treat it like a job interview. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 就……随便组个队什么的，然后玩过家家之类的。或者当成求职面试。我也不知道。

lines.en: : Just come to some sort of an agreement on how Ami would be the better family member so we can get out of here and I can go suck at flirting with some mystery person who is probably just Kaori again.
lines.zh: : 只要你们就「为什么 Ami 更适合当家人」达成某种共识，我们就能离开这儿，我也能去跟那个八成又是 Kaori 的神秘人糟糕地调情了。

lines.en: scene familywar12
: Hey, don’t count me out just yet. I could still win somehow.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别这么快把我排除啊。我说不定还是能赢的。

lines.en: : I mean, {i}sure.{/i} But do you even {i}want{/i} to win? The prize is Sensei. Your victory does nothing but make my life even harder and you’ve done plenty of that already.
lines.zh: : 我是说，{i}当然{/i}。可你{i}真的想{/i}赢吗？奖品是 Sensei。你赢了只会让我的日子更难熬，而这种事你已经干得够多了。

lines.en: : What if I’m just trying to protect you from more heartbreak?
lines.zh: : 万一我只是想保护你，让你不再心碎呢？

lines.en: : Please don’t be. The last thing I need is the endless game of romantic tug-of-war inside of my head to become even more complicated.
lines.zh: : 求你别。我最不需要的，就是脑子里那场没完没了的恋爱拉锯战变得更复杂。

lines.en: : You’re all weird. Can’t I just keep my normal sister?
lines.zh: : 你们都好怪。我就不能留着我那个正常的姐姐吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: scene familywar13
: Well...{i}yes,{/i} on a technical level. But in order to help us with our annual contest, you also need to choose between the lesser of two evils here.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}可以{/i}，严格来说。不过为了帮我们办好这一年度的比赛，你还得在这里两害相权取其轻。

lines.en: : Oh, excellent. I didn’t realize you were both evil as well. Perhaps this won’t be horrible after all.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。我都没意识到你们俩也是坏蛋。也许这次不至于太糟糕。

lines.en: : Aren’t you Papa’s secret daughter? Doesn’t this already make us family?
lines.zh: : 你不是 Papa 的私生女吗？那我们不是本来就是一家人了吗？

lines.en: : Papa? You call my dad “Papa?”
lines.zh: : Papa？你管我爸叫「Papa」？

lines.en: : He’s the only male figure in Chinami’s life. And she also believed that he would marry Chinami’s big sister one day, but those beliefs have been waning lately and that probably won’t happen.
lines.zh: : 他是 Chinami 生命中唯一的男性。她还曾经相信他有一天会娶 Chinami 的姐姐，不过最近这份信念在减弱，大概是不会发生了。

lines.en: : That’s right. Because he is going to marry me.
lines.zh: : 没错。因为他要娶的人是我。

lines.en: : Chinami thinks that is illegal and that you shouldn’t say things like that in public.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得这是违法的，而且你不该在公共场合说这种话。

lines.en: : How about you, Girl-Jeeves? Do you have any weird baggage to drop off as well?
lines.zh: : 那你呢，女仆版 Jeeves？你也有什么奇怪的包袱要抖出来吗？

lines.en: : Girl-Jeeves?
lines.zh: : 女仆版 Jeeves？

lines.en: : Jeeves is the name I give to all of my servants. And you intend to serve me as well, yes?
lines.zh: : Jeeves 是我给所有仆人取的名字。而你也打算侍奉我，对吧？

lines.en: : Hey, new idea. Instead of that, why don’t I teach you how to play guitar? That sounds like a fun activity for brother and sister, right?
lines.zh: : 嘿，新主意。与其这样，不如我教你弹吉他？听起来像是兄妹之间很有趣的活动，对吧？

lines.en: : Are you trying out for the role of my brother? I thought you were a girl.
lines.zh: : 你是在试镜当我哥哥吗？我以为你是女生。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...right. Sister and sister, then. You cool with that?
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……对。那就是姐妹。你没意见吧？

lines.en: : I guess so. Especially if Chinami and this other girl are already related.
lines.zh: : 应该吧。尤其是 Chinami 和另一个女生本来就有血缘关系的情况下。

lines.en: scene familywar14
: Come with me, big sis Ami! Chinami is excited to add another sister to her ever-growing repertoire!
lines.zh: : 跟我来，Ami 姐姐！Chinami 很兴奋能在她不断壮大的收藏里再添一个姐姐！

lines.en: : Big sis Ami?...
lines.zh: : Ami 姐姐？……

lines.en: : Huh...I kind of like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我还挺喜欢的。

lines.en: : Have fun while I’m off becoming the next Jimi Hendrix.
lines.zh: : 我去当下一个 Jimi Hendrix 了，你们玩得开心。

lines.en: : Do you...intend to die by choking on your own vomit after taking a handful of sedatives?
lines.zh: : 你……打算像那样吞一把镇静剂、然后被自己的呕吐物呛死吗？

lines.en: scene familywar15
: Of course I do. I’m rich, aren’t I? That’s how we all go out.
lines.zh: : 当然。我很有钱，不是吗？我们这行人都是这么走的。

lines.en: : Chinami’s death will be much sadder. Which is actually a great segue to where Chinami will take you next!
lines.zh: : Chinami 的死会悲伤得多。而这正好自然地过渡到 Chinami 接下来要带你去的地方！

lines.en: : Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: scene black
: And so they’re off! Is...Is what I probably would be saying if this part of the contest was televised. But it’s not, so...I’ll just go stand in the corner and wait for you to be done.
lines.zh: : 于是她们出发了！如果这段比赛有电视转播，我大概会这么说。可惜没有，所以……我就去角落站着，等你们结束。

lines.en: : Girl.
lines.zh: : 女孩。

lines.en: : {i}Hah.{/i} But first, I will help transport {i}you{/i} since you can’t do anything for yourself right now.
lines.zh: {i}哈。{/i}不过首先，我来帮你搬{i}你{/i}，因为你现在什么都做不了。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, sit here and hold this. I’ve only got like an hour to make an impression on you, so I’m going to make it as cliche and endearing as possible.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，坐这儿，拿着这个。我只有大概一个小时给你留下印象，所以我要尽可能老套又讨人喜欢。

lines.en: : I understand. It’s important to play to your strengths during times of immense pressure. And I am a notoriously hard girl to impress.
lines.zh: : 我明白。在巨大压力下，发挥自己的长处很重要。而我是出了名地难取悦。

lines.en: : If you {i}really{/i} want to earn my favor, though, another option would be teaching me about sexual education since everyone else I know seems reluctant to-
lines.zh: : 不过，如果你{i}真的{/i}想赢得我的好感，另一个选择是教我性教育，因为我认识的其他人似乎都不太愿意——

lines.en: scene familywar16

: Yeah, so that’s not going to happen. Wandering into somebody else’s house and teaching somebody else’s {i}sister{/i} about sex is not a thing I want on my portfolio. Do you have a good grip on the pick?
lines.zh: : 是啊，那是不可能的。跑到别人家里、教别人的{i}妹妹{/i}关于性的知识，我可不想让这种事出现在我的履历上。拨片拿稳了吗？

lines.en: : I...think so? Which part is the pick?
lines.zh: : 我……应该算吧？拨片是哪一部分？

lines.en: : That little triangle in your hands. You’re not really supposed to use it with a classical guitar, but it’ll be way easier learning with this than your fingers.
lines.zh: : 就是你手里那个小三角。古典吉他其实不该用它，不过用这个学比用手指容易多了。

lines.en: : I see. So it’s like the uncivilized version of a bow for violin.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。就像是小提琴弓的未开化版本。

lines.en: : You play violin?
lines.zh: : 你会拉小提琴？

lines.en: scene familywar17
: Not well. I {i}have{/i} played, though. My sister and I receive musical education as part of our at-home curriculum. It mainly involved instruments inaccessible to poor people, though.
lines.zh: : 拉得不好。不过我{i}确实{/i}拉过。我和姐姐在家里的课程里有音乐教育。不过主要还是那些穷人接触不到的乐器。

lines.en: : You know, I’ve got a friend who’s a phenomenal violinist. If you’re interested-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我有个朋友小提琴拉得出神入化。如果你有兴趣——

lines.en: : I’m not. But please don’t let that dissuade you from carrying on with your intent to win my favor.
lines.zh: : 我没兴趣。不过请别因为这就不去继续赢取我的好感。

lines.en: scene familywar18
: Deal. So, what you want to do with this hand is press your fingers down on the strings to form chords.
lines.zh: : 成交。那么，你这只手要做的就是把手指按在弦上，组成和弦。

lines.en: : Like on piano.
lines.zh: : 就像钢琴那样。

lines.en: : Exactly. Just, instead of the keys, you have these little metal bars we call frets. And each fret-
lines.zh: : 没错。只不过不是琴键，而是这些我们叫品丝的小金属条。而每根品丝——

lines.en: : Changes the length of the vibration for a given string, providing a stopping point that ensures accurate frequency and intonation that would be harder to achieve via fretless instrument.
lines.zh: : 会改变某根弦振动的长度，提供一个止点，确保准确的频率和音准——这在无品乐器上会更难做到。

lines.en: scene familywar19
: Oh, shit. Yeah. That’s...damn. You’re, like...legitimately really smart, huh?
lines.zh: : 哦，靠。是啊。这……厉害。你……是真的相当聪明啊？

lines.en: : I absorb information well. It’s just technical skill that I lack. Also, you’re very pretty.
lines.zh: : 我吸收信息的能力很强。缺的只是技术。还有，你很漂亮。

lines.en: scene familywar20
: Technical skill is what practice is for. That’s not something a book can teach you and the only things that’ll ever really help are just repetition and routine. Also, what?
lines.zh: : 技术就是靠练的。那是书本教不了你的，唯一真正有用的就是重复和日常训练。还有，你说什么？

lines.en: : Are you confused about your own teaching or that someone of my status called you pretty?
lines.zh: : 你是对自己教的东西感到困惑，还是对我这种身份的人说你漂亮感到困惑？

lines.en: : The latter, obviously. Is that really something you should be saying to your sister while she’s trying to teach you?
lines.zh: : 显然是后者。你姐姐正在教你的时候，你真该说这种话吗？

lines.en: : It was just an observation, really. My actual sister is pretty as well, but it’s a different type of pretty. Are you a model?
lines.zh: : 其实只是个观察。我亲姐姐也漂亮，不过是另一种漂亮。你是模特吗？

lines.en: scene familywar21
: Focus, okay? Like I said, we don’t have much time to-
lines.zh: : 专心点，好吗？我说了，我们时间不多——

lines.en: : Because you should be.
lines.zh: : 因为你应该去当模特。

lines.en: : Tsukasa-
lines.zh: : Tsukasa——

lines.en: if tsukasacurious == True:
: I’ve been watching pornography lately, and I think you’d find a great deal of success appearing in such works with looks like yours.
lines.zh: : 我最近在看色情片，我觉得以你这副长相出演那类作品，肯定会大获成功。

lines.en: else:
: I hear that nude modeling is also an option for older people as well. I think that would be a good goal for you.
lines.zh: : 我听说裸体模特对年纪大一点的人也是个选择。我觉得那对你来说会是个不错的目标。

lines.en: scene familywar22
: Huh?
: You’d likely make way more money doing that than you would playing guitar as well! You should really consider it.
lines.zh: : 而且你干那个赚的钱，大概会比弹吉他多得多！你真该好好考虑一下。

lines.en: : Sorry. Was that inappropriate for me to say?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我说这话是不是不合适？

lines.en: : I wonder if the mood is this weird over on Ami’s side of the room?
lines.zh: : 我好奇 Ami 那边房间的气氛是不是也这么诡异？

lines.en: scene familywar23
: Chinami would like you to meet the strongest woman who ever lived! This is her Mom, and she died when Chinami was still just a baby.
lines.zh: : Chinami 想介绍你认识史上最强的女人！这是她的妈妈，她在 Chinami 还是个婴儿的时候就去世了。

lines.en: scene familywar24
: Chinami never got a chance to meet her because of that, but she’s heard plenty of stories from big sis Chika about how amazing she was.
lines.zh: : 因为这样，Chinami 一直没机会见到她，不过她从 Chika 姐姐那儿听过很多关于她有多厉害的故事。

lines.en: : What can you tell me about your mom, big sis Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami 姐姐，能跟我说说你妈妈吗？

lines.en: scene familywar25
: Uhh...are you really sure this is what you want to talk about, Chinami? We’ve known each other for a total of five minutes.
lines.zh: : 呃……你真确定要聊这个吗，Chinami？我们总共才认识五分钟。

lines.en: : Chinami introduces everybody she meets to her mom right away! Just like she would if she was still here.
lines.zh: : Chinami 一认识谁，就会马上介绍给妈妈！就像妈妈还在世时她会做的那样。

lines.en: : But Chinami doesn’t get to meet very many people, so things like this don’t happen very often...
lines.zh: : 不过 Chinami 认识的人不多，所以这种事不常发生……

lines.en: scene familywar26

lines.zh: : 所以……

lines.en: : You did this same thing when you met my dad for the first time?
lines.zh: : 你第一次见到我爸的时候，也做了同样的事？

lines.en: : Mhm! But Papa’s reaction was a little different from yours.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！不过 Papa 的反应跟你的有点不一样。

lines.en: : How so?
lines.zh: : 怎么不一样？

lines.en: : Mmm...it’s been a long time since then, so Chinami doesn’t remember it {i}super{/i} well. But what she does remember is that it’s the only time she’s ever seen him look that way.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那是很久以前的事了，Chinami 记得不是{i}特别{/i}清楚。不过她记得的是，那是她唯一一次看到他露出那种表情。

lines.en: : She’s seen him a {i}bunch{/i} of times since then! And even though she annoys him sometimes, he’s still the best dad Chinami’s ever had. Do you feel the same way, big sis Ami?
lines.zh: : 从那以后她又见过他{i}好多次{/i}那种表情了！虽然她有时会惹他烦，但他仍是 Chinami 有过的最好的爸爸。Ami 姐姐，你也是这么想的吗？

lines.en: : My feelings are...a little more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 我的感受……比这复杂一点。

lines.en: : How so? Chinami might still just be a little girl, but she’s good at understanding stuff when it comes to family.
lines.zh: : 怎么说？Chinami 可能还只是个小女孩，但在家人的事情上，她很擅长理解。

lines.en: scene familywar27
: Yeah...it seems like it.
lines.zh: : 是啊……看起来是这样。

lines.en: : Doesn’t it hurt, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，不会痛吗？

lines.en: : Hm? Does what hurt?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么会痛？

lines.en: : Talking about your mom, I mean. Saying all those things about her and knowing you won’t ever get to see her face or...hear her voice or...smell her perfume again? That doesn’t sting?
lines.zh: : 我是说，谈起你妈妈。说那么多关于她的事，明明知道你再也见不到她的脸、听不到她的声音、闻不到她的香水味了？这不会刺痛你吗？

lines.en: : Nope! Not for Chinami.
lines.zh: : 不会！对 Chinami 来说不会。

lines.en: scene familywar28
: But big sis Chika seems to feel that way sometimes...so Chinami is always extra careful talking about her mom around her.
lines.zh: : 不过 Chika 姐姐有时候看起来会那样……所以 Chinami 在她面前提起妈妈时总是格外小心。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s just because she knew her better. Or maybe it’s something Chinami doesn’t understand yet...
lines.zh: : 也许只是因为她更了解她。或者那是 Chinami 还不明白的东西……

lines.en: scene familywar24
: But Chinami thinks it’s more important to celebrate somebody’s life than to get sad about all the things they can’t do anymore! So she tries to stay positive about that stuff.
lines.zh: : 但 Chinami 觉得，庆祝一个人的生命，比为他们再也做不到的事悲伤更重要！所以她尽量对这类事保持乐观。

lines.en: scene familywar27
: You’re stronger than me then, Chinami. It’s been almost a decade since my mom died and I still can’t really talk about it.
lines.zh: : 那你比我坚强，Chinami。我妈去世快十年了，我还是没法真正谈起这件事。

lines.en: : Well, do you {i}want{/i} to talk about it? Because, like she said, Chinami’s a good listener! But if you think she’s too young to understand, big sis Chika also-
lines.zh: : 那，你{i}想{/i}聊聊吗？因为就像她说的，Chinami 是个好听众！不过如果你觉得她太小听不懂，Chika 姐姐也——

lines.en: : Big sis Chika and I don’t really get along. She’s...not exactly a fan of how I look at “Papa.”
lines.zh: : 我和 Chika 姐姐合不太来。她……不太喜欢我看「Papa」的眼神。

lines.en: : Chinami understands that. Big sis Chika is super protective of him because she loves him so much. She even snapped at big sis Yumi and almost threw her over the balcony once because of it!
lines.zh: : Chinami 能理解。Chika 姐姐特别护着他，因为她太爱他了。她甚至有一次对 Yumi 姐姐发火，差点把她从阳台上扔下去！

lines.en: : He definitely has a way of getting us to do crazy stuff like that sometimes, huh?
lines.zh: : 他确实有种本事，能让我们做出这种疯狂的事，对吧？

lines.en: : Big sis Chika does all {i}kinds{/i} of crazy stuff these days. Chinami’s really worried about her. But if big sis Ami can be her friend, maybe it will make her feel a little better?
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐最近做的疯事{i}五花八门{/i}。Chinami 真的很担心她。不过如果 Ami 姐姐能当她的朋友，也许她会好受一点？

lines.en: : I...don’t know about that, Chinami. I feel like some people are just...destined to be incompatible.
lines.zh: : 我……不太确定，Chinami。我觉得有些人就是……注定合不来。

lines.en: : Really? How come?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？为什么？

lines.en: : All sorts of reasons.
lines.zh: : 各种各样的原因。

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如？

lines.en: scene black

scene familywar29
: Okay. So, now that approximately forty-five minutes have elapsed, we will begin the lightning round.
lines.zh: : 好的。那么，大约四十五分钟已经过去了，我们将开始闪电问答环节。

lines.en: : Tsukasa and I will ask you a series of questions that you need to answer as quickly and honestly as possible.
lines.zh: : 我和 Tsukasa 会问你们一系列问题，你们要尽可能快速、诚实地回答。

lines.en: : We will use your answers, combined with our own personal experiences with you today, to come to a conclusion on which of you we’d most like to indoctrinate into our family.
lines.zh: : 我们会根据你们的回答，加上今天我们和你们相处的亲身体验，来得出结论：我们最想把你们中的哪一个吸纳进我们的家族。

lines.en: : She means “include.”
lines.zh: : 她的意思是「接纳」。

lines.en: : No I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Question 1 — If Chinami and Tsukasa wanted to have peanuts for dinner, what would you say?
lines.zh: : 问题一——如果 Chinami 和 Tsukasa 晚饭想吃花生，你会怎么说？

lines.en: scene familywar30
: No. You need much more than just peanuts for a balanced meal and the two of you are still growing.
lines.zh: : 不行。均衡的一餐光有花生远远不够，而且你们俩还在长身体。

lines.en: : I’d say go for it. A little treat every now and then never killed anybody.
lines.zh: : 我会说去吧。偶尔吃点小零食又不会死人。

lines.en: : Well congratulations, Otoha. You just killed Chinami and proved yourself wrong. I hope you’re happy.
lines.zh: : 那恭喜你了，Otoha。你刚刚害死了 Chinami，还证明自己是错的。我希望你满意了。

lines.en: scene familywar31
: Goodbye, cruel world! Chinami has perished. Blaaaah.
lines.zh: : 永别了，残酷的世界！Chinami 死了。哇啊啊啊。

lines.en: : Oh, is she allergic?! How was I supposed to know that?! She’s not even the one I was paired with!
lines.zh: : 哦，她对花生过敏？！我怎么可能知道？！她又不是跟我配对的那个人！

lines.en: : You’ve gotta think outside of the box for stuff like this, Otoha. These girls are smarter than they look and I imagine none of their questions are going to be direct.
lines.zh: : 这种事你得跳出框框想，Otoha。这些姑娘比看上去聪明，我猜她们的问题没一个是直来直去的。

lines.en: : Question 2 — Otoha, are you the same girl who barked at Chinami at the mall that one time?
lines.zh: : 问题二——Otoha，你就是那次在商场冲 Chinami 汪汪叫的那个女生吗？

lines.en: scene familywar32
: Bzzzt! Chinami knows you were and you can’t hide it from her! So weird!
lines.zh: : 哔哔！Chinami 知道就是你，你瞒不过她的！太怪了！

lines.en: : You bark at little girls in the mall, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你在商场里冲小女孩汪汪叫，Otoha？

lines.en: scene familywar33
: I told you I don’t have much experience communicating with kids! And she barked at {i}me{/i} first! What else was I supposed to do?!
lines.zh: : 我说了我不太有跟小孩交流的经验！而且是她先冲{i}我{/i}叫的！我还能怎么办？！

lines.en: : Question 3 — at what age should girls start having sex?
lines.zh: : 问题三——女生几岁可以开始做爱？

lines.en: scene familywar34
: Eighteen.
lines.zh: : 十八岁。

lines.en: : Five-thousand.
lines.zh: : 五千岁。

lines.en: : One more point for Ami.
lines.zh: : Ami 再得一分。

lines.en: scene familywar35
: Did you get these questions beforehand or something? I didn’t even know we were keeping score and you already somehow have three points.
lines.zh: : 你是不是提前拿到这些问题了？我都不知道我们在计分，而你已经莫名其妙拿了三分。

lines.en: : The trick is to just say whatever they want to hear.
lines.zh: : 诀窍就是：她们想听什么就说什么。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. That’s what I thought. And it’s why I agreed to the peanut thing. But now one of them is dead and I’m suddenly the underdog.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也是这么想的。所以我才同意了花生那个。可现在她们其中一个死了，我突然成了劣势方。

lines.en: : You’ve always been the underdog here, Otoha. No one can fairly defeat me in a contest to see who the most family-focused girl is. Family’s all I care about.
lines.zh: : 你在这儿一直是劣势方，Otoha。在比谁最重视家人的比赛中，没人能公平地赢我。家人是我唯一在乎的。

lines.en: scene familywar36
: On that note, let’s ask something a little more abstract and hypothetical. Chinami?
lines.zh: : 既然说到这儿，我们来问个更抽象、更假设性的问题。Chinami？

lines.en: : If there was ever an alternate universe where Papa, AKA: Ami’s dad, turned into a little kid again and then subsequently fell in love with Chinami, would you cause problems at their wedding many years later?
lines.zh: : 如果在某个平行宇宙里，Papa——也就是 Ami 的爸爸——又变成了小孩子，然后爱上了 Chinami，多年后你会在他们的婚礼上闹事吗？

lines.en: : Probably, yeah.
lines.zh: : 大概会吧。

lines.en: : No. In fact, I likely wouldn’t even go.
lines.zh: : 不会。事实上，我大概根本不会去。

lines.en: scene familywar37
: Out of jealousy because you’d wish it would have been you that little Jeeves fell for instead?
lines.zh: : 是因为嫉妒吗？因为你希望小 Jeeves 爱上的是你？

lines.en: : No! Because I don’t like weddings!
lines.zh: : 不是！因为我不喜欢婚礼！

lines.en: : Slight reddening of the cheeks. Elevated heart rate. Constantly looking away. Chinami’s internal polygraph is detecting a lie here.
lines.zh: : 脸颊微微泛红。心率升高。不停地把视线移开。Chinami 的体内测谎仪检测到了谎言。

lines.en: : We’re going to need you to hand over your phone to check for illicit material. We hope you understand.
lines.zh: : 我们需要你交出手机，检查是否有违禁内容。希望你能理解。

lines.en: : There are literally no right answers. I’m being set up. How much did you pay them?
lines.zh: : 这根本没有正确答案。我是被设局了。你给了她们多少钱？

lines.en: scene familywar38
: Phone not handed over. Suspicion not cleared. Confrontation dodged altogether. I have to say, it’s not looking good for you, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 手机未交出。嫌疑未洗清。正面交锋被整个回避。我得说，你的情况不妙啊，Otoha。

lines.en: scene familywar39
: Any chance you could try bombing this next question on purpose just so I can leave here with a shred of dignity?
lines.zh: : 你有没有可能故意答砸下一题，好让我能带着一丝尊严离开这儿？

lines.en: : {i}I know a good website for shotacon that I can show you once we leave.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我知道一个很棒的正太控网站，等我们离开后可以给你看。{/i}

lines.en: scene familywar40
: Okay. It is clear that I am not meant to win this competition. I am graciously bowing out.
lines.zh: : 好吧。显然我注定赢不了这场比赛。我优雅地退出。

lines.en: : {i}You’re not alone. It’s everyone else who’s weird.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你不是一个人。是其他所有人都很怪。{/i}

lines.en: scene familywar41
: Oh. You guys are done already? I thought the lightning round was going to last a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 哦。你们已经结束了？我还以为闪电问答会多持续一会儿呢。

lines.en: : It was supposed to. But then Otoha got scared that her deepest, darkest secret would be revealed.
lines.zh: : 本来是的。可后来 Otoha 害怕自己最深的黑暗秘密会被揭穿。

lines.en: : Really? Can {i}I{/i} know? I think I’m owed some sort of embarrassing information after she managed to make it through our entire relationship without ever revealing a single weakness to me.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？{i}我{/i}能知道吗？毕竟她跟我相处这么久，一个弱点都没暴露过，我觉得我该得到一点丢人的情报。

lines.en: : I’ll tell you when you’re younger.
lines.zh: : 等你再大点我就告诉你。

lines.en: : Thanks. I-
lines.zh: : 谢了。我——

lines.en: scene familywar42
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Have you guys come to a decision yet? My friend’s contest is next and I want to try and make it over to the school before it starts.
lines.zh: : 你们得出结论了吗？我朋友的比赛是下一场，我想赶在开始前到学校去。

lines.en: : We have. Chinami — would you like to do the honors?
lines.zh: : 得出了。Chinami——你愿意来宣布吗？

lines.en: scene familywar43
: We, the esteemed elders of the Wizard Council and heads of the board of directors at Chinami-Corp, have elected big sis Ami as our new big sister!
lines.zh: : 我们，巫师议会的尊贵长老、Chinami 公司董事会的首脑，在此选举 Ami 姐姐为我们新的大姐姐！

lines.en: scene familywar44
: No offense to you, Otoha. I actually liked spending time with you, even if it was only for thirty minutes. You’re way nicer to me than my actual sister is.
lines.zh: : 无意冒犯，Otoha。其实我很喜欢跟你待在一起，哪怕只有三十分钟。你对我比我亲姐姐好多了。

lines.en: : It really came down to the fact that big sis Ami comes with added benefits for her dad as well. And you don’t really bring anything to the table in that regard.
lines.zh: : 归根结底是因为 Ami 姐姐还附带着她爸爸这个额外好处。而你在这一方面确实没什么可提供的。

lines.en: : So I lost because I’m not related to Sensei. Got it. This definitely wasn’t rigged at all.
lines.zh: : 所以我输是因为我跟 Sensei 没有血缘关系。明白了。这绝对没有一点黑幕。

lines.en: : You win some, you lose some. Just, in this case, you lost some. But hey, maybe there will be another contest you can win after this?
lines.zh: : 有赢就有输。只不过这次你输了。不过嘿，也许之后还有别的比赛你能赢？

lines.en: : The Dorm Wars only happens once a year.
lines.zh: : 宿舍战争一年只有一次。

lines.en: : Oh. Then have fun wallowing in mediocrity until then, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 哦。那在那之前，就好好享受你的平庸吧。

lines.en: scene familywar45

: You’re heading over to the school to support Maya, Ami? Would you mind relaying the results of this match to Imani when you get there? I need to head over to the hotel to meet up with Uta before our thing.
lines.zh: : Ami，你要去学校给 Maya 加油？到了那儿能麻烦你把这场比赛的结果转告 Imani 吗？我得在活动前赶去酒店跟 Uta 碰头。

lines.en: : Sure, I’ll let her know. Are you guys all staying over there tonight or heading back to the dorms after?
lines.zh: : 好，我会告诉她。你们今晚都住那边，还是之后回宿舍？

lines.en: : I promised I’d help Nodoka with something, so I’ll be there.
lines.zh: : 我答应了要帮 Nodoka 做点事，所以我会去。

lines.en: : I’ll be there too. Chika as well since I’ll likely need to drag her. Which leaves you two alone, it seems. Is this legal? Are we allowed to leave or does someone have to stay behind?
lines.zh: : 我也去。Chika 也去，因为我大概得把她拖过去。看来就剩你们俩了。这样合法吗？我们可以走吗，还是得有人留下来？

lines.en: : I will stay. Bad things will happen if I do not.
lines.zh: : 我留下。如果我不留下，坏事就会发生。

lines.en: scene black
: B...Bad things? What are you-
lines.zh: : 坏……坏事？你是什么——

lines.en: : She probably doesn’t want to be around for your {i}date{/i} as it increases the likelihood of her actually murdering someone.
lines.zh: : 她大概是不想在你的{i}约会{/i}期间待在旁边，因为那会增加她真去杀人的概率。

lines.en: : Chika, it’s not a real date. It’s-
lines.zh: : Chika，这不是真的约会。这是——

lines.en: : Violence.
lines.zh: : 暴力。

lines.en: : {i}Noooo.{/i} No violence. Be good. Watch her, Chinami.
lines.zh: {i}不oooo{/i}。不许暴力。乖一点。看着她，Chinami。

lines.en: : Okay! And goodbye, everyone!
lines.zh: : 好的！大家再见！

lines.en: : Have fun with your genocide!
lines.zh: : 好好享受你们的种族灭绝！

lines.en: : See you later, guys! Text me about that site, Otoha!
lines.zh: : 回头见，各位！Otoha，记得把那个网站发给我！

lines.en: : Site? Like a...music thing? Or-
lines.zh: : 网站？像是……音乐方面的？还是——

lines.en: : Hahahah! Nope, it’s nothing. I will also leave now. Goodbye!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！不，没什么。我也走了。再见！

lines.en: : Uhh...bye, you two!
lines.zh: : 呃……再见，你们俩！

lines.en: : Please...take care of your sister.
lines.zh: : 请……照顾好你的姐姐。
